SELECT a."ARTregID"                                        AS artifact_id,
       a.art_title                                        AS title,
       r.risk_level                                       AS risk_level,
       ra."HIST_sign"                                     AS historical_significance,
       json_extract(ra.rating_profile,'$.cultural_score') AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r  ON r.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ra ON ra."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
WHERE r.risk_level IN ('High','Medium')
  AND ra."HIST_sign" > 8
  AND json_extract(ra.rating_profile,'$.cultural_score') > 20

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link"              AS artifact_id,
         a.art_title                AS artifact_name,
         a."ageYears"               AS age_years,
         sd.env_handling_sensitivity AS j
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
  JOIN "ArtifactsCore" a ON a."ARTregID" = sd."ART_link"
),
scored AS (
  SELECT sens.*,
         (CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.light') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.temperature') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.humidity') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.pollutants') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.vibration') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) / 5.0 AS erf,
         CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.light') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END AS light_weight,
         (CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.light')       = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.temperature') = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.humidity')    = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.pollutants')  = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.vibration')   = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_count
  FROM sens
)
SELECT artifact_id,
       artifact_name,
       erf AS erf_score,
       (SELECT json_group_object(t.key, t.value)
          FROM json_each(scored.j, '$.environment') t
         WHERE t.value = 'High') AS high_sensitivity_summary
FROM scored
WHERE erf > 4
ORDER BY erf DESC
note: ERF = mean of the five $.environment sensitivities (light, temperature, humidity, pollutants, vibration) with Low=1/Medium=5/High=10. Ambiguity: NULL ratings are scored 0 and the divisor is fixed at 5; if instead you average only the non-NULL ratings, ART54317 rises from 4.0 to 6.67 and would also pass the >4 filter. The 'High' summary is a json_object over the same environment block; if it was meant to cover the whole sensitivity document it would also pick up context/handling_transport keys. Only 3 artifacts have SensitivityData rows (its PK is ENVsense).

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id,
         a.art_title  AS title,
         a."DYNASTY"  AS dynasty,
         ((ra."HIST_sign"
        + json_extract(ra.rating_profile,'$.research_score')
        + json_extract(ra.rating_profile,'$.cultural_score'))
       * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                 WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                 WHEN 'Good'      THEN 3
                 WHEN 'Fair'      THEN 5
                 WHEN 'Poor'      THEN 7
                 WHEN 'Critical'  THEN 10
               END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ra ON ra."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming','Qing')
)
SELECT artifact_id,
       title,
       dynasty,
       cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi_score > 7 THEN 'High Priority'
            WHEN cpi_score >= 4 THEN 'Medium Priority'
            ELSE 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM cpi
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC
note: Conservation status maps Excellent=1..Critical=10; 150 artifacts have an empty conserve_status, which makes CPI NULL (one such Qing row falls through to 'Low Priority'). CPI 4 exactly is treated as Medium Priority ('between 4 and 7'), which conflicts slightly with the 'Low Priority for <= 4' wording.

SELECT a."DYNASTY"      AS dynasty,
       ((ra."HIST_sign"
        + json_extract(ra.rating_profile,'$.research_score')
        + json_extract(ra.rating_profile,'$.cultural_score'))
       * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                 WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                 WHEN 'Good'      THEN 3
                 WHEN 'Fair'      THEN 5
                 WHEN 'Poor'      THEN 7
                 WHEN 'Critical'  THEN 10
               END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score,
       cm.budget_alloc AS budget_allocation,
       cm.budget_stat  AS budget_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ra           ON ra."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca      ON ca.art_exam   = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e  ON e.case_link   = ca.case_exam
JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = e.monitor_code
WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL AND a."DYNASTY" <> ''
note: CPI per knowledge.md; budget joined artifact -> ConditionAssessments -> EnvironmentalReadingsCore -> ConservationAndMaintenance (the only path, since ConservationAndMaintenance has no artifact key). Only 10 artifacts have an ArtifactRatings row (its PK is HIST_sign, so the table holds just 10 rows), so the report is 11 rows (one artifact's showcase has two monitors). Every artifact has a dynasty, so 'known dynasty' filters nothing. I read 'specific budget allocation' = budget_alloc and 'generalized budget status' = budget_stat, and listed exactly the four columns named in the question (no artifact ID).

         sd.env_handling_sensitivity AS j

         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.humidity') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.pollutants') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.vibration') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) / 5.0 AS erf,
         CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.light') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END AS light_weight,
         (CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.light')       = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.temperature') = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.humidity')    = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.pollutants')  = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.vibration')   = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_count
  FROM sens
)
SELECT s.artifact_id,
       s.artifact_name,
       e."TEMPc" AS current_temperature,
       e."RH"    AS current_humidity,
       s.high_count AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN (s.age_years * s.erf * (e."RH" - 50) * (e."RH" - 50) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0 > 5
             AND s.high_count >= 2
            THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration_scenario
FROM scored s
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca     ON ca.art_exam = s.artifact_id
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
ORDER BY s.artifact_id
note: 'Include all artifacts' is read as 'do not filter to only the Yes rows'; the MDR and high-sensitivity count both require SensitivityData, which only covers 3 artifacts, so the report is 3 rows rather than a LEFT JOIN over all 995 artifacts. Temperature/humidity come from the showcase's EnvironmentalReadingsCore row reached via ConditionAssessments.

SELECT DISTINCT case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
WHERE "tempVar24" > 1 OR "RHvar" > 3
ORDER BY showcase_id
note: Showcase id taken as EnvironmentalReadingsCore.case_link; 545 showcases qualify.

WITH sc AS (
  SELECT s."caseID" AS showcase_id,
         json_extract(s.case_environment_profile,'$.physical_state.leak_rate_per_day') AS leak_rate,
         json_extract(s.case_environment_profile,'$.physical_state.seal_state')        AS seal_state,
         json_extract(s.case_environment_profile,'$.maintenance.maint_status')         AS maint_status,
         json_extract(s.case_environment_profile,'$.maintenance.filter_status')        AS filter_status,
         json_extract(s.case_environment_profile,'$.maintenance.silica_status')        AS silica_status
  FROM "Showcases" s
)
SELECT DISTINCT sc.showcase_id
FROM sc
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = sc.showcase_id
WHERE (10 - ((e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0 + sc.leak_rate) / 3.0)) < 5
   OR ( (CASE WHEN sc.seal_state    = 'Poor'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      + (CASE WHEN sc.maint_status  = 'Overdue'     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      + (CASE WHEN sc.filter_status = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      + (CASE WHEN sc.silica_status = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) >= 3
ORDER BY sc.showcase_id
note: Uses the Secondary Stability Threshold (SESR < 5) as the question states. In this data SESR never drops below ~8.8 (tempVar24 <= 2, RHvar <= 5, leak <= 0.5), so all 67 results come from the >=3 maintenance-indicator branch.

scored AS (

         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.temperature') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.humidity') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.pollutants') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.vibration') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) / 5.0 AS erf,
         CASE json_extract(j, '$.environment.light') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END AS light_weight,
         (CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.light')       = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.temperature') = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.humidity')    = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.pollutants')  = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN json_extract(j,'$.environment.vibration')   = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_count
  FROM sens

SELECT s.artifact_id AS registration_id,
       s.erf
       + (l.lux * s.light_weight * l."visLxh") / 1000.0
       + 2 * ((s.age_years * s.erf * (e."RH" - 50) * (e."RH" - 50) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0) AS tetl_score
FROM scored s
JOIN "RiskAssessments" r            ON r.art_concern = s.artifact_id
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca      ON ca.art_exam   = s.artifact_id
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e  ON e.case_link   = ca.case_exam
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l  ON l.env_link    = e.monitor_code
WHERE r.risk_level = 'Medium'
ORDER BY tetl_score DESC
LIMIT 10
note: Risk levels present are High/Medium/Low, so 'second-highest' = 'Medium'. Only 2 of the 3 artifacts with sensitivity data are Medium, so the top-10 returns 2 rows. ART54317 has NULL lux, so its LER and therefore its TETL are NULL (sorted last); I did not coalesce lux to 0. Same ERF null-handling caveat as museum_artifact_2.
